# Vicnez Facilities Management W.L.L

> Vicnez Facilities Management W.L.L is a Bahrain-based facilities management and cleaning company serving residential, commercial, industrial, hospitality, retail, healthcare, and educational properties.

## Official website

- [Home](https://www.vfmbh.com/): Company overview, service promise, and client sectors.
- [Services](https://www.vfmbh.com/services/): Full service scope, including cleaning, maintenance, pool care, construction cleaning, and staff supply.
- [About](https://www.vfmbh.com/about/): Company values, leadership, safety practices, industries, and quality process.
- [Contact](https://www.vfmbh.com/contact/): Official contact details and quote request form.

## Core services

- Residential and commercial cleaning
- Specialized, outdoor, and post-construction cleaning
- Building maintenance: electrical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry, painting, masonry, and waterproofing
- Swimming pool cleaning and maintenance
- Service staff and housekeeping supply

## Service area and contact

- Service area: Kingdom of Bahrain
- Head office: Al Guful, Manama, Bahrain
